result.question: What happened to Uzziah while holding a censer?

readings.answer: Leprosy broke out on his forehead.
readings.support: with a censer in his hand to offer incense | leprosy broke out on his forehead
with a censer in his hand to offer incense, was enraged

assessments.reason: Verse 26:19 says “with a censer in his hand … leprosy broke out on his forehead,” directly matching the key.
The text also says “Uzziah, with a censer in his hand … was enraged,” so being enraged happened while he was holding the censer.

result.reason: The passage reports both that Uzziah was enraged while holding the censer and that leprosy broke out, so either could answer the question as worded.
